title: Implement encode() — produce well-formed UU output
description:
Implement pub fn encode(data: &[u8], filename: &str, mode: u32) -> Vec<u8> in src/encode.rs.

Output format: begin {mode:03o} {filename}\n <data lines> backtick\n end\n

Line encoding: process input in 45-byte chunks. For each chunk: emit length char (chunk.len() as u8 + 32), then encode groups of 3 bytes into 4 chars. encode_char: if v == 0 use backtick (avoids trailing-space stripping), else v + 32. Pad last group with null bytes; length char governs actual byte count.

mode: 3-digit zero-padded octal. filename: verbatim (caller must not embed newlines).

Output is Vec<u8>.

Tests (oracle: UNIX uuencode or Python uu module, NOT this crate):
- encode b'Cat' -> verify exact begin/data/end bytes
- round-trip encode then decode -> original bytes
- 45-byte aligned input
- 1, 2 byte final remainders  
- mode formatting: 0 -> 000, 755 -> 755
